Author: Kait
Name: Easy Social Media Plugin
Description: Draws buttons beside the Adventurer Plate and Examine windows that open F-list (/c/ marker), X (@handle), Carrd (.carrd.co), RefSheet (ref.st/name), and RpHub (rphub.co/ch/) profiles found in a player's search comment. Also adds an Open F-list Profile context-menu action and the /social command for your current target.
Punchline: Open F-list and X profiles advertised in player search comments.

Author: Kait
Name: RetroFFXIV
Description: A multi-core libretro emulator embedded in a Dalamud window. Drop any libretro core into the cores/ folder — SNES, GBA, Genesis, and more. Keyboard and controller support, configurable key bindings, resolution scaling, CRT effects, friend spectating, and netplay.
